reviews.comment: Dr. Ottman is a great professor! She cares about students developing writing skills, so she strongly discourages AI use. All groups for activities and assignments are randomized. She is always willing to answer questions and help with writing in her office hours. She is flexible with assignment submissions if you have an extenuating circumstance.

The class is fun and the workload is manageable, I did very much enjoyed this class. The lectures are entertaining and she has a unique way of teaching that keeps everyone engaged, definitely one of my favorite classes. However, I'll say the grading is stricter but if you show up to class, give effort, and attend office hours an A is very doable.
Feedback on projects was vague and it didn't feel like she put a lot of effort in to class. If teaching isn't going to be her top priority why should I care about the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

Dr. Ottman is a great professor for English 104 and 203. There are a few essays to write but, it's not hard to write. She grades pretty tough for English 104 but makes the class interesting and engaging.

reviews.comment: If you do the work and participate in the office hours you will do great. By no means is this an "Easy A" class but if you work hard, try your best, and ask questions, you will pass. Ottman is very nice and enthusiastic. Seems like she really loves her job. Does her best to keep up with Gen Z slang. Do not bring bread to her class....
Ez class. Multimodal projects are annoying but easy. Chatgpt did 90% of the actual writing work, which should tell you how serious things are.

Ottman is a great person. The due dates will change on a semi-regular basis. She's a fine professor but doesn't do much "teaching". There is little to no instruction in the actual classroom, and she grades rather harshly considering. Go to her office hours. Regularly. I did not but if I had I'm sure I would have done better. Also read everything.

Every project uses "multimodal texts" and it's very repetitive. The class is not difficult, although it's really boring and I honestly didn't learn much that I didn't already know how to do. Ottman is very kind, but the lectures are just not interactive or interesting. I didn't think that the textbook was worth buying at all.

Textbook was expensive and unhelpful.  Professor Ottman doesn't actually teach how to write an essay, you know the point of this class.  Nothing I learned was useful in my other classes, other teachers don't actually want you to write this way!!  Nice but frustrating.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tries too hard to seem relatable, wish she'd just use her natural charm instead she has plenty. Could be a more traditional teacher.

When I was planning on doing this English class, I was ready to be bored and struggle because I hate English. Dr. Ottman is the first English professor that I have ever had that made English fun. Though she tends to grade hard, if you talk to her about your essays you will be fine in the class and she is really helpful.
Dr. Ottman is a kind professor who truly cares about her students. She gives good detailed feedback and is available and willing to help each of her students who put in the work.

I love Prof Ottman she is So great! I had her last semester and I can't stop thinking about her CLass!! She's Very willing to bend over backwards to help you Grow. Definitely go to office hours. I only wish she offferred extra credit, that would have really helped relieve some stress for me. still, she is great, take her if you can!!

reviews.comment: Dr. Ottman is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students. Her lectures are very stimulating and interactive and you're not just listening to her lecture. She is very understanding over late work, and is very fair when grading. Gives good feedback in a timely manner, and just is an amazing human all around.
Kind of cringe. Definitely presents herself like a baddie but she's pretty basic. Not bad.

She is a phenomenal human being. She is very easy to work with and believes in the mental health of students! Her essays are easy. Textbook is not required, but if you want you can still get it. I never bought the textbook and did great in her class. Reading book is though. Overall easy A+!

reviews.comment: She is a great professor and gives great feedback for papers. Cares a lot about every member participating in group projects. Also has 1000 hours in dead by daylight.

What can I say.. I LOVED this class but I hate English. Professor Ottman is so interactive and will do anything to help you succeed if you want it. Shes also just so dang relatable and makes class fun.

One of my favorite English professors, her lectures are interesting and she keeps good conversation with the class. Go to her office hours its probably the most beneficial thing you can do to improve your grade on any of your papers. Shes a really fair grader and gives tons of feedback on the stuff youve submitted. 10/10 would take again!

reviews.comment: Professor Ottman is the best english teacher I've ever had. She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to do well. Stay on top of your assignments and it's not hard to get a good grade. Do not be afraid to go to her and ask for help, she is more than happy to meet with you and help you with anything. I highly recommend.

Amazing professor overall, just make sure you participate and go to class. She genuinely cares about working with her students and gives entertaining and interesting lectures. None of the assignments are hard just get on it as soon as possible. Would definitely take a class of hers again and this is coming from someone who doesn't like writing.
